tei:div.tei:p: "$ (209)༄༅// snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i yum bka' rgyas pa'i mngon dkyil dang dbang bskur gyi cho ga bdud rtsi bum pa zhes bya bzhugs so/// /

(210)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ bla med bla ma gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro de la phyag 'tshal zhing nye bar skyabs su mchi'o// gsang ba bcom ldan padma rā ga'i mdog /dngos kun rang bzhin spros pa kun gyis stong*// bde gshegs ma lus skyed cing sbyor ba'i yum// bde ster dpa' mo khyod la phyag 'tshal nas// snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i mngon dkyil gyi// chog 'grigs gong ma'i man ngag bzhin du bri// de yang bcom ldan 'das ma dpal gsang ba lhan skyes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang dang sdom pa thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ spros med zab mo sindhu ra rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan don du dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ blo ldan man ngag gi de nyid dang ldan pa dag gis rgyud las gsungs pa'i gnas dben zhing nyams dga' ba yid dang mthun par phyag bdar dang chags chags gdab/ gu gul dang sha chen gyis bdug /rgyan dang rten mchod bkram/ rje btsun ma'i thang sku'am/ sku'i bkod pa bsham/ dbus su maṇḍal gru bzhi pa byas la a mṛ ta dang dri bzang gis byugs pa la las dang ye shes kyi thig btab la chos 'byung bsnol ma dbus dang zur drug la dga' 'khyil dang*/ dbus su pad nyi ro gdan la lha mtshan gri gug dang*/ pad 'dab bzhi la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'am phyag mtshan bkod pa'i phyi rol padma 'dab brgyad dam pad ra rdo ra dang dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba me 'od (211) kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa bri bar snyan brgyud kyi yig cha rnying ma rnams las gsungs kyang*/ 'dir phyag bzhes su sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor kho na la brten pas 'thus par yang mdzad/ rgyas bsdus gang mdzad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi sogs khri'i khar bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsang ba dang sbyang ba byas pa'i nang du bum rdzas rgyas pa'am dri dang sman gang 'dzom gyis bkang zhing mgul chings dar dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs dang ldan par bzhag

/de'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan dum bu gcig pa'i nang du myos byed kyi bdud rtsis bkang la sindhū ra dang sbyar ba'i steng du zhing skyes kyi bu mo'i lag nas byung ba'i me long dri ma med pa la/ phyi rol gnas dang nang du mtshan ldan ma las 'bab pa'i sindhū ra gnyis sing ras la btsags te des byugs pa la gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rje rtse lnga pa chos 'byung bsnol ma khug drug la dga' 'khyil yod pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod me ris bskor ba'i dbus su pad 'dab kyi lte bar nyi zla'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar bam̐ gyi mtha' mar oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba bris la bzhag de la dar dmar po'i zhal khebs kyi steng du tsakli'am rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnal 'byor mar dmigs te gzungs thag dang bcas pa bzhag shar du rakta dang kundas byugs pa'i stegs kyi khar bandha dum gcig lcang lo can gyi nang du brgyud pa'i dam rdzas dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod bzhag gzhan yang dbang rdzas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ snyan brgyud kyi glegs bam/ nor bu rin po che sogs brda dpang bcu gsum (212) gyi rdzas dang mig dar dang me tog rnams bzhag las bum du dri bzang gi chu dang bum rdzas dang bdud rtsi ril bu bag tsam sbyar ba'i chus bkang la nub byang dang gdan gyi khar bzhag mthar mar me la sogs pa'i nyer spyod tshar bdun re bsham/ gong du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma bzhi/ gtsang gtor gcig dang bcas pa nas phud la bshams shing de la sha dang zan gyis bskor bar gsungs pa ltar bya/ 'og tu stobs dang myos byed la sogs pa'i tshogs rdzas la zhal zas kyi rigs sna tshogs pa bzhag /'bul gtor la rgyas par yul nyer bzhi'i lha grangs dang bstun bdun bshams par gsungs so// de ltar na bla ma mnyes pa'i maṇḍal/ yi dam mnyes pa'i mchod pa/

mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs 'khor rgya chen/ chos skyong mnyes pa'i gtor ma bsham par gsungs pa ltar bya ba yin no// dkyil 'khor la dar dmar po'i 'grib yol cis kyang bya/ gzhan yang bla bre dang phyi yol sogs byas la dam tshig dang ldan pa ma gtogs phyi nang gi mtshams bsdam/ mdun du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje dril bu dang ḍa ma ru sogs bzhag /mdun gyi mthar stegs dang bcas pa'i dkar gtor dang*/ sgrub pa pa rnams kyi glud gtor gyi changs bu bsdus la sha chang la phug sogs kyis sbags pa bshams pa sogs tshogs chen dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa 'jug pa la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma'i 'jug pa'o// dang po la'ang sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes thob kyi bya ba'o/ dang po ni/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs yin na nangs par mnal sad pa'i dus kyi tshe nam mkha' la rnal 'byor ma bzhis ḍa ma ru'i sgras bskul te/ mnal sad par mos nas dag pa gsum gyi skur langs pa'am/ sgrub mchod kyi cho ga la 'jug pa lta bu'i tshe na sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams sgrub pa'i thog mar sgo gsum dag par bya ba ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis lhag pa'i lha rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku lus dag pa lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ sogs nas/ ha kṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rlung phyi nang brjod du med pa ngag dag pa sngags kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ bdud rtsi ril bu bza' ba'am byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i a mṛ ta mtheb srin gyis blangs te lce la bzhag nas/ oṃ badzra bhā rā hī (213)a haṃ/ badzra gnyis med ye shes te// bhā ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// rā ni spros dang bral ba ste// hī ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa// a haṃ bde ba chen mo'o// bla ma yab yum gyi byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas yid dag pa zag med bde stong gi ye shes su gyur/

zhes brjod cing de rnams kyi don dran par byas la/ thog mar nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdud rtsi chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang / oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu yi dbyibs can ba dan dang chang bzung la yam̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i zur gsum la kam̐ kam̐ kam̐ gsum las mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas ka pā la dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ de'i nang du pam̐ las padma ra kā li las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ā li las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du ma las klad gzhung*/ nub tu shū las byang sems/ lhor ra las rakta/ dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lho go las rta'i sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las ba glang gi sha /byang shar du ha las glang po che'i sha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu/ rlangs pa oṃ lhungs pas rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ āḥlhungs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa kha gdengs pa khong sing gi lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas mkha' spyod/ sa spyod/ sa 'og na spyod pa sogs dang*/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gri gug dang thod khrag can gyi tshul dpag (214)tu med pa spyan drangs par gyur/ hūm̐ la thim/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba ye shes kyi rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsis gtor ma rnams bran zhing*/ mchod rdzas la'ang bdud rtsi'i chu gtor nas/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi dang*/ swa bha was sngar bzhin sbyangs par byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ yig gi tshogs dpag tu med pa yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshogs ngo bo stong pa la zag med bde ba'i rang bzhin rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod rdzas su snang ba dwangs shing thog pa med pa 'phro bas chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par 'gengs shing 'khor ba'i mu mthar thug gi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho 'phro ba'i dam tshig tu gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyāṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du sngags kyi thog mtha' gnyis sbyar la/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai widya/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ gi bar brjod pa ni mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'o// spro na rdor dril byin rlabs kyang yab bka' ltar bya ba'am/ yang na ḍa ma ru blangs nas/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bhū ta kṣetra pra tsa li ni/ pradzña pā ra mi tā nā tha sambha we/ badzra dharmā hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ zhes ḍa dril drag tu dkrol la rol mo dang mchod rdzas la byin dbab pa'o// de nas tshogs chen gyi dus ltar dkar gtor byin gyis brlabs nas yul bdag la gtor ma gtong zhing bka' bsgo bya'o// glud gtor byin rlabs 'gugs gzhug sogs byas la gung ka ris bsngo zhing nyer spyod kyis mchod cing*/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// zhes sogs kyis nag phyogs kyi 'byung po la gtor ma byin la bgegs bskrad drag po bya'o/

༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ bdag bskyed sgrub pa/ bum (215) sogs sgrub pa/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa'o// dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba blon po rig ma gsum las byed/ dngos gzhi rgyal mo chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ rjes thob 'bangs phrin las mthun sbyor rnams so// dang po la'ang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dang gnas khang byin gyis brlab pa'i don du thog mar/ sumbha ni sa bgegs bskrad pa'i rjes su/ 'og tu āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar yangs shing rgya che ba de las yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas de thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur te/ 'og thams cad sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ logs thams cad rdo rje rim pa lnga'i ra ba zlum po dang*/ rdo rje mda'i ra ba dang rdo rje me ri'i gur khang du gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badzri bhā wa badzra bhandha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bhindhi ni hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pra kā ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pañdza ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dza la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas srung 'khor bsgom mo// sa gzhi thams cad o rgyan rang byung gi dur khrod chen po mi ro dang rta ro khral khrol du 'dug pa/ rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung du 'dug pa/ chu rnams thams cad khrag dang rnag tu 'dug pa/ sgra skad thams cad dud mo'i skad du sgrogs pa/ mtshan bzhin du me 'bar ba/ nyin bzhin du rlung 'tshubs pa/ ri bo thams cad he ru ka pho mo ltar bro khrigs khrigs/ gar khyug khyug tu 'dug pa/ de'i dbus su dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang pa/ mi mgo rlon pa la nang gi rtsig pa byas pas nang dmar ba/ skam po la phyi yi rtsig pa byas pas phyi dkar ba/ dur khrod kyi rus pa dum bu la khrog byas pa/

go ro tsa na dang dri chen gyis zhal byas pa/ mi chen po'i keng rus la ka ba dang gdung ma byas pa/ bu tsha chung ngu'i keng rus la gshag grab byas pa/ phyogs bzhi la sgo yod pa/ logs bzhi la rus chen gyi phreng ba'i dra ba dra phyed gser gyi dril chung g.yer khas mdzes pa/ de'i phyi rol du mda'i ra ba/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i phyi rol tu 'og rdo rje'i sa (216)gzhi/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol ye shes kyi me dpung bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me ri dmar nag g.yon ngos su 'khyil zhing 'tshubs pa'i gur khang du gyur/ gnas khang de nyid kyi steng gi cha la bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang grub thob pho mo sprin bzhin du gtibs pa/ rgyab tu dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang g.yas g.yon du rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs/ mdun du chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dpung nge thibs se byin gyis rlob pa'i tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ skabs 'dir dag pa gsum gyi skur bzhengs pa gzhung gi dgongs don ji lta ba yin yang*/ rje mar pas mdzad pa'i yab bka'i 'grigs dang bstun nas gong du byas pa yin/ skyabs yul de dag gi drung du/ 'gro drug sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la mchis kyi bar du skyabs mgon dpung gnyen dam pa bla ma dkon mchog khyed mkhyen snyam pa snying khung rus pa'i gting nas byas te/ bdag gzhan ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes sogs dang*/ gnas 'og min bde ba chen po'i pho brang na// longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa la gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// mar pa lho brag pa la gsol ba 'debs//

zhes pa nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi'i 'don bya ji ltar rigs par byas te/ btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya ba'i phyir du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa blon po rigs gsum las byed dngos la gsum ste/ sgrib sbyong rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang*/ (217 )byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ ting nge 'dzin he ru ka'i bdag dbang dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor pam̐ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen 'khor lo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum rab tu dmar zhing g.yo ba/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i gar gyis bzhengs pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang rus pa'i rgyan drug rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba du mas brgyan pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi phung po gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing dam tshig gi ye shes dang gnyis su med pa/ de'i 'khor lo lnga la padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pa rdor rje sems dpa' yab yum sku mdog dkar po/ mgrin par gar gyi dbang phyug yab yum dmar po/ snying gar he ru ka yab yum sngon po/ lte bar rdo rje nyi ma yab yum ser po/ gsang gnas su rdo rje rgyal po yab yum ljang gu ste/ yab yum thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs gtso bo lta bu mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/

de dag gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying ga so so'i mdog gi padma'i steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi steng na hūm̐ so so'i mdog can gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai widya/ shabda sogs kyis mchod nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon du 'khor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ (218)badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rokta me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badzra he ru ka ma me muñtsa badzra he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐/ zhes bgrangs la thugs rgyud bskul bar bsams te sngags bgrang zhing*/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' rigs bsdus kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngon po dpag tu med pa na ra ra tshangs bug tu bab/ lus phyi nang thams cad khyab/ phyi lus kyi sdig sgrib/ nang sems kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rkang mthil sor mo'i rgyud du nag nur gyis thon nas/ lus thams cad shel gong dag pa ltar gyur pa'i nang du rdo rje sems dpa' rigs bsdus yab yum thams cad kyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar na ra ra babs/ spyi bo tshangs bu ga nas zhugs lus gnas rtsa'i dkyil 'khor khyab cing ba spu'i bu ga dang lhug lhug gang bar gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' rigs bsdus kyi rang bzhin gyi bde mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na skabs 'di'i thun bar rnams su gtor ma byin gyis brlab/

badzra he ru ka i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul la/ bla ma rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsungs// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod pa bya ba'am/ dkyus kyi tshe gtor ma mi 'bul na/ ārghaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa'i rjes su/ bla ma dam pa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs gyur pas// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i dam (219)tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ skad cig gis rang nyid lhag pa'i lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan par gyur pa'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la me ri 'od phung gi dbus na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten brten pa dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i 'dom gang tsam gyi steng gi bar snang la pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su ā li kā li zla nyi sbyor ba'i steng du drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa chen po ngo bo bla ma rnam pa 'khor lo bde mchog /sku mdog utpal ltar dwangs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po che zla phyed rdo rje nor bu dang bcas pa gar gyi nyams dgu/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ thugs rje tshad med pa'i spyan rtsa dmar kyi le gzigs pa de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ brgyad 'phros pa las/

de rnams phyi rol gyi pad 'dab brgyad la zla ba'i steng du shar du ind+ra bhū ti mi sha kha/ byang du ku ku ri ba du ba'i mdog can/ nub tu padma badzra padma rā ga'i mdog lhor klu sgrub snying po gser btso ma'i mdog /shar lhor ḍombhi he ru ka dmar smug /lho nub tu rdo rje dril bu pa gser btso ma'i mdog can/ nub byang du lū ha pa mthing mdog /byang shar du sa ra ha pa thal ba'i mdog can te/ grub chen brgyad sku mdog so so la rdo rje thod pa yum dang bcas pa ral pa'i thor cog dang*/ spyan rtsa rab tu dmar zhing g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum du bzhengs pa'o// bla ma he ru ka'i thugs kar sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du dpal tai lo pa chen po yab yum sku mdog mthing nag yab kyis rdo rje thod pa dang yum gyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog rgyan thams cad dang ldan zhing*/ g.yas bskum g.yon (220)brkyang bde ba chen po'i nyams kyis yongs su gang ba'i spyan rtsa rab tu dmar zhing g.yo ba/ de'i yang padma 'dab brgyad la grub chen brgyad so so'i sku mdog ltar gsal ba/ de rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rim bzhin rdo rje 'chang gi bar thams cad gar thabs su bzhengs shing yab yum gnyis su med pa/ zhal nas ā ra li dang pheṃ gyis sgra sgrogs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi phung po mkha' 'gro ma bye bas bskor pa de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ ma hā gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharmā pā la kā ya wāktsittas pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ma hā gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharmā pā la kā ya wāktsittas pa ri wā ra badzra ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta badzra ma taṃ gi/ zhes phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod la/ na mo sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ sogs dang*/ bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku sogs shlo ka gsum dang*/ ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ sogs dang*/ bya spyod rnal 'byor sogs dang*/ ston pa'i bstan pa sogs dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa sogs brjod/ maṇḍal rgyas pa 'bul ba'am bsdu na/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing sogs dang*/ mnyes byed maṇḍal sogs kyis 'bul/ mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ces pa nas/ bdag 'jug gi skabs ltar 'don rgyu btsud/ lags so// chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'khor dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag rnams kyi sngon tshe rabs zhes pa bshags pa rgyas pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen gzigs lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ ces pa nas/ byang zhing dag par mdzad du (221)gsol/ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki n+yi/ rdo rje 'chang chen dbang phyug tai lo pa// zhes sogs gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod kyi gdung dbyangs dang bcas pa byas pa'i rjes su byin rlabs kyi dbang bzhi len pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'khor dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ grol bar mdzad du gsol/ grol ba mthar phyin par mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin he ru ka'i bdag dbang ni/ 'di nas bzung ste dmigs pa gsal pos yid 'don bya/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo de nyid kyis rlung tshur rngub pa lta bur mdzad par brten nas/

rang nyid bla ma de nyid kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar tai lo pa'i zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems dang bcas pas de'i gsang ba nor bu nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ yum gyi spyi bor thug tsam du byas pa dang*/ yang mar drang yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams thig le gcig tu gyur nas babs/ rnal 'byor pa brgyad kyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems thig le re re babs pa dang tshur 'dus gcig tu gyur nas mdun du pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed chung ma dang bcas pa'i steng du rang nyid bde mchog yab yum gar gyi nyams dgu dang mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan par gyur par bsgom pa de ni bum pa'i dbang ngo*// yang rang nyid de ltar gnas pa'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod par gyur/ nyer spyod lha mo bcu drug sngags 'bul dang*/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta dang*/ badzra ma taṃ gi sa mchod do// de ltar yid kyi mchod pa phul/ 'od zer yar 'phros/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thams cad kyang yab yum gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i byang sems dkar dmar sbyor mtshams su babs pas rang gi lce la zhugs/ des lus rtsa'i pho brang thams cad khyab/ ngag gi nyes pa dag ste gsung gi dkyil 'khor brjod du med pa ā li kā li'i (222)rang bzhin mngon du gyur/ gsang dbang thob/ yang gong ltar yid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i/ 'od zer gyis lha tshogs thams cad bskul te/ yum las yum gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros nas/ rang gi lus la thim/ yum bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byas/ bsrub pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba las/ spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems babs/ rtsa yi gnas bzhir dga' ba bzhi rgyud la skyes te gyen du ldog pa ni/ hūm̐ ha/ ke ha/ ke hig /ces brjod pas gsang ba nas lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor haṃ la bstim/ bde stong gi ye shes lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rgyud la skyes par bsam/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob yang yid kyi mchod pa dang*/ 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu// sna tshogs chos rnams bde ba che// bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /bla ma bla ma phyag rgya che// zhes gsungs nas rnal 'byor pa brgyad gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo rang la thim/ rang nyid 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku can du gyur pa'i ngang la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag go /des tshig dbang rin po che thob/ tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs rnams kyang rang nyid la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs thams cad dbyer med du gyur/ rang nyid phyi snod nang bcud chos 'byung lha dang bcas pa ltem gyis 'od du zhu ba'i stong pa'i rang las rang nyid byang chub kyi sems padma rā ga li khri ltar dmar ba/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od zer las rab tu rnam par gsal ba/ ngo bo mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa/ mtshan nyid gnyis pa dngos gzhi rgyal mo chos nyid mi 'gyur pa dngos ni/ yid kyi dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas bde mchog phyi sgrub dang snyan brgyud man ngag 'don pa'i dus ltar ngag bcad la sgra bcas su mi 'don zhing rang gis tshor ba tsam du 'don pa yin no// mchan/ tshad dang gzhal du ma mchis pa'i bde ba chen po nyid do// zhes gsal btab la de'i ngang la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag /de nas sems 'phro bar gyur na/ de'i (223) ngang las zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa ni/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glus bskul bar mos te/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dgyes ma hoḥ// bde ba chen po rdo rje ni// bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid las// 'di nyid du ni bzhengs su gsol// oṃ shrī badzra ma hā yo gi nī ka ya wāktsitta swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khor lo drug dbyer mi phyed pa'i dpal rdo rje/

zhes pa'i sgra thos ma thag rnal 'byor ma lha lnga lus kyi dkyil 'khor chos 'byung bsnol ma'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje me ri dang bcas pa gcig char du skad cig gis bzhengs pa rim gyis gsal gdab pa ni/ hrīḥlas chos 'byung bsnol ma'i khug drug las dga' ba 'khyil pa drug pa yangs shing rgya che ba de'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer bye ba phrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du pam̐ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gsang ba ye shes lhan cig skyes ma sku mdog bskal ba'i me ltar rab tu dmar zhing gsal ba/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum rab tu dmar zhing khrol khrol gyi gzigs pa g.yo ba/ zhal mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams nas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas 'debs pa'i tshul du thur du brkyangs pa/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po gan rkyal bsgyel ba'i brang bar du mnan pa/ g.yon bskums nas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mgo bo sum ltabs su mnan pa/ dbu skra sil ma sku rgyab tu grol ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ ba su ta la brgyus pa'i thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs dang me tog gi phreng bas rab tu brgyan pa/ bde ba chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nyams kyis yongs su gang bas ba spu nu ma langs shing bha ga rab tu rgyas shing padma rā ga mngon bzhin pa/ cung zad sgeg (224)pa'i gar gyis gzhon sha rab tu rgyas pa/ nyi ma bye ba 'bum gyi 'od zer las ches rab tu 'phro ba/ zhal nas ā ra li pheṃ zhes bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs phyogs kun tu sgrogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ sprul pa yang sprul gyi mkha' 'gro ma nam mkha'i mtha' steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'gengs shing bzhad pa'i gad mo cher sgrogs pas 'jig rten thams cad 'dar zhing ches g.yo bar mdzad cing zil gyis gnon pa/

de'i shar gyi pad 'dab kyi steng du nyi ma la mām̐ las mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo// byang du tām̐ las lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu pām̐ las khaṇḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor mām̐ las gzugs can ma ser mo// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang g.yon pa rnams kyis thod khrag bsnams shing kha ṭwāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ bcu drug lon pa ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing bde ba chen pos rab tu rgyas shing mngon par chags pa'i spyan zur gyis gzigs pa can/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dkyil tu 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhengs pa/ 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i sa gzhi'i steng du rdo rje rim pa lnga'i gur dang bla bre/ de'i phyi rol tu ye shes lnga'i me ri me dpung sna tshogs pa rab tu dmar zhing g.yon ngos su 'khril zhing 'tshubs par gyur par bsgom/ de ni phyi dkyil lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yin la/ bdag bskyed kyi lus dkyil lha so bdun po yongs rdzogs bsgom pa ni/

de ltar bsgoms pa'i snying gar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma pad ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhengs pa/ bam̐ dang mam̐ tam̐ bam̐ tam̐ las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo spyi bor pulli rā ma la ya nas/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tā yan chad kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa mdud rnams su/ puṃ dzāṃ auṃ aṃ/ goṃ reṃ deṃ maṃ/ kāṃ oṃ triṃ koṃ/ kaṃ laṃ kaṃ hiṃ/ preṃ graṃ sauṃ suṃ/ nāṃ siṃ maṃ kuṃ/ sa bon de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad nyi ro yi gdan la gnas pa'i rlung sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ (225)rnams yongs su gyur pa las rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi gsal gdab pa ni/ spyi ba pūlli ra ma la yar rnal 'byor ma rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dzā landhar rnal 'byor ma gtum pa'i mig can ma/ ma dper yi ge ma gsal/ ltag pa ārbu tār rnal 'byor ma sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon pa go da wa rir rnal 'byor ma blo gros ma/ smin dbus ra mai shwa rar rnal 'byor ma mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭir rnal 'byor ma lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la wa ra rnal 'byor ma shing grib ma'o// de dag ni nye ba'i gnas te thugs kyi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog nag mo mkha' la spyod pa brgyad 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye ba bye bas yongs su bskor ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o// mchan khung gnyis kā ma ru par rnal 'byor ma sa srung ma/ nu ma gnyis o trer rnal 'byor ma 'jigs byed chen mo/ zhing ngo*/ lte ba tri sha ku ner rnal 'byor ma rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rnal 'byor ma chang 'thung ma/ nye ba'i zhing*/ kha ka liṅkar rnal 'byor ma sngo sangs lha mo// mgrin pa laṃ ba kar rnal 'byor ma shin tu bzang mo/ tshandho ha/ snying kañtsir rnal 'byor ma rta rna ma/

lgad pa hi ma la yar rnal 'byor ma bya gdong ma ste de dag ni nye ba'i tshandho ha ste gsung gi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo sa la spyod ma brgyad 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye ba bye bas yongs su bskor ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ mtshan ma pre ta pu rir rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang la gṛ ha de war rnal 'byor ma dum skyes ma/ 'du ba/ brla gnyis sau raṣṭar rnal 'byor ma chang tshong ma/ byin pa gnyis su warṇa dwī par rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug nā ga rar rnal 'byor ma shin tu dpa' mo// bol gong gnyis sindhū ra rnal 'byor ma stobs chen ma dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhi ma rur rnal 'byor ma (226)'khor los skyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tār rnal 'byor ma brtson 'grus chen mo'o// de dag ni nye ba'i dur khrod de sku yi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dkar mos 'og na spyod ma brgyad 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye ba bye bas yongs su bskor ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku yi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo thams cad sku mdog so so la zhag gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ bcu drug lon pa ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing nu ma bha ga rab tu rgyas pa/ bde ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa'i yongs su chags pa'i mdangs kyi spyan rtsa dmar kyil kyil gyis gtso bo la mngon par gzigs pa'o// de nas kha la shar sgor khā gdong ma/ sna la 'ug gdong ma/ mtshan ma'i sgor khyi gdong ma/ bshang sgor phag gdong ma/ de ni 'thung gcod do// mig g.yas par gshin rje brtan ma/ g.yon par gshin rje pho nya mo/ rna ba g.yas par gshin rje mche ba ma/ rna ba g.yon par gshin rje 'joms ma/

de dag ni nye ba'i 'thung gcod de dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma/ shin tu khros shing gtum pa'o// de ltar gnas pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu rigs kyi bdag po bla ma bde ba chen po dang bcas pa/ gdod ma nas dam tshig dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa chu yi zla ba lta bu/ gsal la rnyog pa med pa mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bur gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge mi shigs pa'i thig le/ ye shes drug gi bdag nyid bam̐ gyi rnam pa'i tha mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su bkod pa g.yon du 'khor bar gyur/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa la dmigs nas ci nus su mnyam par bzhag cung zad ting nge 'dzin las ldang ba'am bzlas pa byed par spro na bcom ldan 'das ma'i bzlas rim chen mo ltar/ sku gsal gdab kyi bzlas pa dang*/ ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs rim gyis rtags dang bstun zhing de nas yid rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs byas pas/ de ltar bsgoms pa (227) las byung ba'i bde drod gsal la mi rtog pa dang*/ du ba smrig rgyu dang*/ srin bu me khyer/ mar me lta bu/ mkha' gsal lta bu dang*/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' dngas pa lta bu'i zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba'i 'od gsal ba chen po/ gsal la sgrib g.yogs med pa/ stong la phyogs ris med pa/ 'di la zag pa med pa'i ye shes rtogs shing mngon du byed par 'gyur ba ni/ gdams pa 'di'i bsgrubs 'bras thun mong ma yin pa yin gyis/ las tshogs dang mkha' spyod 'grub pa tsam ni yon tan thun mong ba'o// thun 'jog pa'i tshe thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer las mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug dpag tu med pa sprul pas mchod pa'i sprin tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' bar snang yongs su gang bas bdag la mchod cing bstod par

dmigs la / oṃ badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐ zhes dang / oṃ badzra wī ṇi āḥhūm̐ de bzhin du / wi she/ mu rañdze/ mṛ taṃ ge ha syā/ lā sya/ gī ti/ nṛ tyi/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ rū pa/ rwa sa/ sparshe/ dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ rgyas par na gzhung las byung ba'i yum gyi rtsa sngags dang lha mo so bdun gyi snying po dang thun mong min pa'i rkang brgyad kyi sngags kyis mchod cing bstod pa ni snyan brgyud kyi phyag bzhes yin la/ spro na rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga dang*/ nang gi mchod pa/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa/ badzra ma taṃ gi āḥhūm̐/ zhes bya ba rnams kyis mchod la/ oṃ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo ni// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa ma lus skems shing pham mdzad pa// skye gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// zhes pa'i shlo ka gnyis kyis bstod cing*/ mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad bdag la thim par mos/ rdzogs (228 )rim 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pas mnyam par 'jog cing ting nge 'dzin de las ldang ba'i tshe rang nyid rten brten pa dang bcas pa lha'i nga rgyal du bya ba ni/ skad cig gis rang nyid zung 'jug gzugs kyi skur gsal ba'i lte bar am̐ bam̐ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo// snying gar ham̐ yam̐ las gshin rje gshed ma sngon mo// mgrin par hriṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo// spyi bor hriṃ hriṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/

spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag gi tshigs thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa gtum mo tsaṇḍi ka dud ka /thams cad yig 'bru lha'i rang bzhin/ drag po'i 'od zer phyogs kun tu 'phros pas gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i go cha gsal bar gyur par bsgom zhing spyod lam dang rnal 'byor gyi cho ga bsgom pa la 'jug cing*/ thun mtshams su/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis smon lam gdab par bya'o// skabs 'dir bdag bskyed la mchod pa sogs kyi don du lag mchod bya ba ni/ sngar gyi nang mchod bshams pa de nyid/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsang*/ g.yon bar mtheb srin sbyar bas g.yon skor du zlum skor byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba ཿswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ g.yon skor du chos 'byung bris la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ g.yas skor gyis chos 'byung gnyis pa bris la/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ dang*/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir thig le byas la/ bām̐ mām̐ lām̐ pām̐ tām̐/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das gsang ba ye shes lhan cig skyes ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su gsal bar gyur lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i mthil du chang gtor nas/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsang*/ sngar ltar zlus skor dang chos 'byung gnyis dang dbus kyi thig le lnga byas nas/ dbus kyi thig le lnga po yongs su gyur pa las yum gsang ba ye shes lhan cig skyes ma sku mdog dmar mo de yi phyogs bzhi bde chen gyi rnal 'byor ma bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ thams cad kyang phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī ārghaṃ sogs nas nyer spyod dang nang mchod/ a mṛ ta dang*/ (229 )gsang ba/ ma taṃ gi sa mchod nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes sogs kyis mchod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par gyur/

oṃ badzra wā rā hī sa phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod la dkyil 'khor gsum po thun mong du rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ spro na yab bka' ltar rang gi lag pa gnyis su dbyangs gsal bkod pas bdud rtsir sbyangs shing go cha'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i bar byed pa snyan brgyud rang lugs yin yang bsdus pa la dga' na/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams lag pa'i dkyil 'khor dang de yang bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la thim pas dkyil 'khor gsum po dbyer med gcig tu 'dres te 'od du zhu ba las byung ba zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la g.yon skor du lan gsum dkrugs la/ mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsir blangs nas gnas khang dang mchod rdzas dang rang nyid rnams la 'thor zhing*/ gnas dang rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams srung ba'i 'khor lo'i gur khang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas gtams par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes smin mtshams nas steng 'og rim bzhin gtor la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan dang yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs mchod par 'os pa rnams la 'bul ba'i mthar rang gi yang lce la myong zhing mgrin par byug go /gsum pa rjes thob 'bangs 'phrin las bdun sbyor ni 'og tu gsal ba ltar yin la/ spyi don gnyis pa bum sogs bsgrub pa ni/ bum bskyed zur du byed par spro na/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ kha g.yel ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bum pa gzhal yas khang hrīḥlas chos 'byung bsnol ma'i khug drug la dga' ba 'khyil pa drug pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhes pa nas/ me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhengs pa/

las (230)bum gyi nang du pad nyi ro yi gdan la bam̐ las dum skyes ma sku mdog dmar mo sogs yab bka' ltar bskyed nas/ lha tshogs de rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po sogs yab bka' ltar spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ de nas dbang lha spyan 'dren mchod pa dbang bskur dbur brgyan rnams mdun bskyed ltar bya'o// de nas mchod pa nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang lha mo bcu drug gis mchod la bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// zhes dang*/ ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs kyi skabs su/ chos rjes dran pa'i ngo bo nyid// gos dkar mo de me yi khams// padma'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yum// dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon dang sngags 'khor las sngags phreng 'phros te gzungs thag la brten nas song ba bum lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas bum par thim/ bum lha rnams bde ba chen po'i bcud kyis rgyas pa'i byang sems dang phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar dang so so'i sku las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ hūm̐ zhes gzungs thag blangs la g.yon pas snying gar bzung zhing g.yon pas phreng ba la grangs bya/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa ni ha ri ni sa ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sam yang na gtso mo kho na la brgya skor ci mang dang*/ 'khor rnams ci nus zur du bzlas kyang rung*/ gzungs thag rdo rje las bum du spos la/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa la brgya rtsa brgyad man chad ci 'grub bzlas pa byas la/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐

zhes dung chos yod na de yi chu bum par blugs/ lha'i 'khor lo chags pa chen po'i mes byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ puṣpe brjod la me tog gis kha bcad pa'i kha rgyan bzhag /las bum la bum chu gtor zhing reg la/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs bar bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig / ces dang*/ grub nas mchod bstod dang bcas (231) pa bzhag go /de nas gsum pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor yod na de dang bcas pa thams cad la dmigs rten bya/ de ltar min kyang skabs 'di'i dkyil 'khor dngos kyi gtso bo sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor kho na yin pas de la dmigs yul gtso bor bya zhing*/ de dang bum pa gcig tu sgrub na bum bskyed zur du ma byas kyang chog par 'dug go /des na mdun du dkyil 'khor yod na de dang min kyang sindhū'i dkyil 'khor la/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi dkyil 'khor hrīḥlas chos 'byung bsnol ma khug drug la dga' ba 'khyil ba drug pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer bye ba phrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du bam̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma gsang ba ye shes lhan cig skyes ma sku mdog bskal ba'i me ltar rab tu dmar zhing gsal ba/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum rab tu dmar zhing khrol khrol gyi gzigs pa g.yo ba/ zhal mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams nas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas 'debs pa'i tshul gyis/ thur du brkyangs pa/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i brang bar du mnan pa/

g.yon bskums nas dus mtshan ma dmar po mgo bo sum ltabs su mnan pa/ dbu skra sil ma sku rgyab tu grol ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ ba su ta la brgyus pa'i thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs dang me tog gi phreng bas rab tu brgyan pa/ bde ba chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nyams kyis yongs su gang bas ba spu nu ma langs shing bha ga rab tu rgyas pa'i padma rā ga mngon bzhin pa/ cung zad sgeg pa'i gar gyis gzhon sha rab tu rgyas pa/ nyi ma bye ba 'bum gyi 'od zer las ches rab tu 'phro ba/ zhal nas ā ra (232)li pheṃ zhes bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs phyogs kun tu sgrogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ sprul pa yang sprul gyi mkha' 'gro ma nam mkha'i mtha' steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'gengs shing bzhad pa'i gad mo cher sgrogs pas 'jig rten thams cad 'dar zhing ches g.yo bar mdzad cing zil gyis gnon pa/ de'i shar gyi pad 'dab kyi steng du nyi ma la mām̐ las mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo// byang du tām̐ las lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu pam̐ las khaṇḍa ro hi dmar mo// lhor lām̐ las gzugs can ma ser mo// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod khrag bsnams shing kha ṭwāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ bcu drug lon pa ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing bde ba chen pos rab tu gang bas mngon par chags pa'i spyan zur gyis gzigs pa can thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dkyil tu 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhengs pa/ 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba yangs shing rgya che ba sa gzhi'i steng du rdo rje rim pa lnga'i gur dang bla re/ de'i phyi rol tu ye shes lnga yi me ri me dpung sna tshogs su rab tu 'bar zhing g.yon ngos su kyi li li 'khyil zhing 'tshubs par gyur/

de ltar lha tshogs gsal bar gnas pa'i gtso mo'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu rigs kyi bdag po bla ma bde ba chen po dang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang gdod ma nas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa chu yi zla ba lta bu/ gsal la rtog pa med pa mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bur gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge mi shigs pa'i thig le/ yi ge drug gi bdag nyid ye shes sems dpa' bam̐ gyi rnam pas mtshon pa/ de'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i sa bon dang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas o rgyan rang byung gi dur khrod chen po nas gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par

mos la cung zad langs pa'i rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong gis g.yon (233) mnan la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya ni lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis sbyar/ mdzub mo gnyis mdud byas gung mo gshibs/ mthe'u chung dang srin lag gis mdzub mo bzhi bsgrad de dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor la/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ oṃ e badzra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ/ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya hūm̐/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes pa nas/ mkhyen gyur cig /bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo 'khor bcas rnams// sems can don la dgongs mdzod la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// zhes mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// zhes dang*/ stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// sogs nas/ bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ gu ru badzra bā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā ya wāktsitta badzra sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ pañtsa ka la sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ sogs/ dbang bskur dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ lā ma la don yod grub pa/ khaṇḍa ro hi la 'od dpag med/ gzi ldan ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs rgyas par byas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer las mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul te/ mchod pa'i sprin tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad yongs su gang bas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rnams la mchod cing bstod par

dmigs te / oṃ badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ (234)nai wi dya/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ de nas thog mar thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra bhā rā hī/ pro ta ge pro taṃ ge ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ kiṃ ki ni khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badzra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badzra kha ṭwāṃ ga kā pa la dhā ri ṇi/ ma hā pi shi ti māṃ sā sha ni/ ma nu ṣyāṃ tra pra bṛtte sanni dhyaṃ/ nā ra shi ro mā lā graṃ thi ta dhā ra ṇi/ sumbha ni sumbhe/ ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ sarba pā pa sa twa nāṃ/ sarba bā shū nāṃ/ ma hā māṃ sa tstsha da ni/ kro dha mu rte daṃshatra ka rā li ni/ ma hā mu dre shrī he ru ka de wa sya a gra ma hi ṣi/ sa ha sra shi re/ sa ha pra wā ha be sha ta sa ha sra ā na ne dzwa li ta te dza she dzwa la mu khi piṃ ga la/ lo tsa ne badzra sha rī re/ badzra ā sha ne/ mi li mi li/ ti mi li ti mi li/ he he/ ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ ru ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ a twai te/ ma hā yo gi nī pa thi ta siddhi/ draiṃ dhaṃ draiṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me taṃ/ ha sa ha sa/ bi re/ hā hā/ hoḥhoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lo kya bi nā sha ni sa ta sa ha pra/ ko ṭi ta thā ga ta/ pa ri wā ri te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ se dha rū pe khaḥg dza rū pe gaḥ/ āḥtrai lo kyo da re ma hā sa mu dra me kha la gra sa gra sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī rā rwe te hūm̐ hūm̐ haḥhaḥm hā pa shū/ mo ha ni ma hā yo gī shwa ri st+waṃ/ ḍā ki ni sarba lo kā nāṃ/ bandha ni sadya pra tya ya kā ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhū ta trā sa ni ma hā bī re pa ra ma siddhe/ yo gī shwa ri phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ pra tsaṇḍe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ākṣe ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bhā wa ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ma hā na me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bī re ma tī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dru matstsha ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ai rā ba ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhe ra bi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ba yu be ge ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhakṣī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shyā ma de wi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya karme huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ga a na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shauṇḍi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bi re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā (235)bī rye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags kyis mchod/ gzhan yang skabs 'dir spro na/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang rdung*// zhes sogs tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am/ bsdu na so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra wī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du thog mtha' sbyar la/ waṃ she/ mṛ taṃ ge/ mu rañdze/ hā sya/ lā sya/ gī ti/ nṛ tya/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gandhe/ rū pa/ rā sa/ sparshe/ dharma dhā tu/ zhes pa dang rgyal srid bdun/ 'dod yon lnga dang nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi gtor la/ brgyud rim dang yi dam gyi mtshan gyis 'bul te/ pañtsa a mṛ ta sa mchod/ bde ba chen po'i mchod pa'i 'dun pas/ badzra ma taṃ gi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams kyis mchod la bstod pa ni/ oṃ nā mo bha ga wā tyai badzra wā rā hī bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bī dye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bhū ta bha yā ba he ma hā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzrā sha ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shyaṃ ka ri ni tra bhrā ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ sho ṣa ni ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi dza ye dzambha ni st+waṃ bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi kā me sha ri kha gi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ hūm̐ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing mchod la rang la bsdu/ rdzogs rim 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /bdag mdun 'di rnams kyi rjes thob kyi skabs su/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor// bgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor/ 'gro 'dug spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor dang bzhis bya spyod tshogs su bsgyur ba dang*/ dang po tha ma khrus dang chos spyod gnyis te/ de ltar na bkru ba khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang bya cha chos spyod kyi rnal 'byor dang drug po ni/ rje btsun ma'i rgyal blon 'bangs kyi sgrub thabs nyid ltar nyams su len par bya'o// skabs 'dir phrin las gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma'i yo byad la/ gnang bkag med pas gtor gzhong gtsang ma gang yang rung ba'i nang du mtheb kyu la sogs pas (236) bkang bar byas la gsungs pa ni/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi dus dang 'dir gtor mchod dang 'bul gtor rgyas pa yod pa la ni gtor ma rnams la dang po phud rgod kyis bran/ de nas chu blugs/ gsum pa bdud rtsis bran zhing lha'i nga rgyal gyis sumbha ni 'am/ khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsang swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu yi dbyibs can/ ces pa nas sngon gyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/

gtor mgron mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar spyan 'dren/ nyer spyod sogs kyis mchod/ lag pa rdo rje thal mo phye ste bskor zhing se gol brdabs pas thugs ka'i baṃ las mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa 'phros nas/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsir bcas nas thams cad la drangs par mos pa/ thog mar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'bul bar dmigs la/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa la sogs te rim bzhin/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad brnyes nas mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de nas/ grub chen brgyad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs bde chen gyi rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pa'i 'khor dpa' bo so bdun po rnams la so so'i sngags ring sogs sngags thams cad brjod pa'i mthar/ i daṃ ba lingta btags shing 'dod don gsol ba dang bcas pa gsang sngags nang gtor ltar rgyas par 'bul lo/ skabs 'dir tshogs kyi gong du gtor bsngos mdzad pa ni/ cho ga snga ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba yin la/ tshogs kyi rjes gtor bsngos mdzad pa rje don ldan man chad kyi kar lugs kyi phyag len du 'dug pas 'dir phyag len snga ma ltar gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa rgyas par bya'o// des ni cho ga'i rim pa slob dpon gyi 'jug pa'i bya ba rnams so// gnyis pa slob ma'i 'jug pa la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ las bum gyi chus slob ma rnams khrus bya zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ oṃ tsakṣurbhandha wā ra ma na ye swā hā/ zhes gdong g.yogs bcing*/ oṃ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog lag tu gtad/ de nas sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar dkar gtor gcig dang sgrub bo rnams kyi glud gtor bshams la/

gzhi bdag la gtor ma btang zhing bka' bsgo byed/ 'byung po la bgegs gtor (237 )btang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i nas kyis bgegs bskrad cing rol mo drag tu byas nas mthar srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan por bsgom/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis yol ba'i phyi rol nas phyag 'tshal sngon du 'gro bas maṇḍal phul nas bsam pa bzang po rtse gcig pas 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad gdams par bya ste/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ spyir ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams la 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin spong bar byed pa'i thabs kyi theg pa'i 'jug sgo mang du gsungs kyang sems can rnams kyi blo yi bye brag tha dad pas gang la gang mos kyi tshul mthun du sbyangs te mthar thug theg pa chen po gcig nyid du rtogs par byed pa yin la/ theg pa chen po la'ang byang chub sgrub pa'i rgyu lam du byed pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa gsang sngags kyi lam gnyis kyi khyad par du 'phags pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa/ de'i nang nas kyang rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud zab cing de la'ang byin rlabs can gyi rgyud bde mchog 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i bstan pa kun gyi mthar thug dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bya ba yin/ de nyid kyi'ang yang snying don gyi gnas lugs su nges pa kun las kyang gsang ba rmad du byung ba ni mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud dri ma med pa 'di yin la/ 'di la'ang smin grol gnyis las smin lam yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba yin/ smin lam yang thabs shes gnyis kyi sgo nas ston pa las/ 'dir ni shes rab dang 'brel pa bcom ldan 'das dpal lhan skyes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhū ra rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang skur bar byed pa'o// de la spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di byin rlabs kyi lam yin/

sgos su snyan brgyud 'di byin rlabs kho na'i lam yin/ byin rlabs kyang mos gus la rag las pas thog mar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la bka' rtags kyi chos bzhi/ zab pa'i gnad bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ston pa ni sa steng rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gsungs pa'i bla ma dam pa ste/ (238)rgyud ldan des kyang slob ma snod ldan mtshan nyid tshang zhing khyad par gyi yon tan bco brgyad dang ldan pa gcig gam gsum las mang ba la spel du mi rung ste/ gcig la ma bcad zab mo'i rigs brgyud chad// gnyis las ma spel gsang ba nyams sa re// zhes gsungs pas sbyangs pa'i las 'phro sad cing rigs dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma de nyid kyis dad gus drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ bcom ldan bde chen rnal 'byor ma// skyabs med skyob pa skyob med skyabs// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// rgyu med par ni thugs rje che// mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid che khyod ci 'dra bar// gtso bos bdag la de 'drar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba bdag la skyabs mdzod cig / ces lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla ma zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid ci ltar rigs pa dang*/ khyad par du zab mo'i tshul 'di'i rtogs pa lam du byed pa'i dbang bskur ba'i tshul yang gsum du yod pa yin te/ thog mar bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bde mchog yab bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs kyi dbang bskur nas rgyud 'chad pa'i snod du rung bar byas te yab la brten pa'i bskyed rdzogs phyi nang gi rnal 'byor nyams su len par byed pa la dbang dang 'brel ba rgyud kyi gdams pa zhes bya/ lhan skyes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang bskur dang byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas snyan brgyud zab mo bla na med pa'i man ngag rnams nyams su len pa la byin rlabs dang 'brel pa snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zhes bya ste/

lus med ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma'i brda dbang ngo sprod la brten nas lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu la sogs pa nyams su len pa la brda dang 'brel pa ngo sprod kyi gdams pa zhes bya ba rnams yod pa las/ da res bde mchog snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i gsang lam zab mo'i man ngag ston par byed pa la dbang bskur (239)byin rlabs kyi smin byed zab mo 'di nyid kho nas rgyud smin par byed dgos pa yin/ de lta bu'i gsang ba bla na med pa'i sgor 'jug par byed pa la thog mar rgyud dag par byed pa'i bsags sbyangs mchog tu gyur pa bdun rnam dag gi tshogs bsags gal che bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rangs ba dang*/ thun mong du skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan don du bsngo bar bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal mchod// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang gang*// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// bsgoms dang bzlas brjod bsod nams la// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin du ni sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// 'jig rten sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol//

zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub thob// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// ces brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan par dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yi bka' las 'da' mi bya// 'das na brlag (240)'gyur dam tshig srungs// zhes brjod/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa ste yol ba phyi 'jug yin te snga ma'i cho ga rnams las byung ngo*// gnyis pa dbang gi dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo ru gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes gnang sbyin pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum ste/ ye shes dbab pa/ me tog dor ba/ spyan 'dren cing lha ngo bstan pa'o// dang po ni yol ba phyi 'jug ltar na las kyi rdo rjes khrid nas nang du gral byas te bzhag la bla mas slob ma'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing dri yi thig le byas la/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo mtshal li khri'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga bcug pa/ gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer las ches 'bar ba de lta bu'i rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdor yi ge hrīḥyig dmar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas u rgyan dang mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du puṣpe sogs dang*/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta dang*/ badzra ma taṃ gis mchod la / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma//

zhes sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod nas/ da ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kyis/ bdag la de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po nam mkha' lta bu lham me lhan ne lhang nger mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma mdun du langs la rkang ba gnyis gshibs pa'i g.yas pa'i mthe bong gis g.yon pa mnan la/ rting pa cung zad yar bkyag /lag pa gnyis chos 'byung gi phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la lus drang por bsrang*/ mig gyen la ldog /ngag gi gnad ni 'jam rlung cung zad bzung*/ yid kyi gnad ni ting nge 'dzin 'di ltar sgoms mdzod ces brda sprad nas / mdun gyi nam mkhar (241)bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phog pas 'od du zhu nas/ thig le dmar po shin tu bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa zhig dmar kyi li li byed par sgoms mdzod/ ces dpon slob gnyis kas dmigs pa drag tu gtad la/ gu gul dang sha chen byi la nag po'i brun sogs 'bebs rdzas rnams kyi spos kyis bdug cing*/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'das ma'i snying po drag tu brjod cing rol mo dkrol la skor cig phab/ de nas slar yang dmigs pa gsal gdab pa ni/ de nas thig le de yongs su gyur pa las/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khyed rang slob ma rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ba'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa sku mdog mthing nag /spyan rtsa dmar la 'khrugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug dang ldan pa/ gar stabs su bzhengs shing phyag na cang te'u dang dril bu 'khrol bzhin pas/

zhabs g.yon skor kyi li li mdzad pa/ gsang gnas bde spyod kyi 'khor lo dga' ba 'khyil ba'i steng du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gar stabs kyi tshul du rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pas cang te'u dang dril bu 'khrol nas g.yon skor kyi li li byed pa/ de gnyis kyi bar du bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa sku chung la yan lag rags pa gzi brjid che zhing rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pas/ cang te'u dang dril bu 'khrol zhing zhal nas pheṃ pheṃ gyi sgra sgrog cing gar stabs kyi tshul du yar 'byon mar 'byon byed pa/ de dag rnams kyi 'od zer gyis mdun gyi nam mkhar bka' brgyud bla ma grub thob pho mo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sa gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis nam mkha' dang bar snang thams cad yongs su gang ba/ 'ur 'ur shig shig tu byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi ba spu'i bu gar thim/ bde stong gi nyams phri li li rgyud la skyes/ zhabs kyi padma dang nyi ma'i gdan g.yas g.yon du 'khor bar (242)gyur/ zhes brjod la bla mas snying po'i rjes su/ kā ya wakra tsitta hriṃ hri dza dzaḥ ā we sha ya ā we sha ya a āḥ zhes lan mang du phab pas/ phebs pa'i tshe ye shes phebs pa de rang sems su ngo sprod pa'i don du bla mas snying po bzhi'i glu len pa ni/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sna tshogs chos rnams rang gi sems// sems ni stong nyid mtshan nyid med// 'od gsal mkha' ltar dri med pa// bde gshegs kun gyi gsang ba'i gnas// rnal 'byor ma dpal dngos nyid de// mthong bas ye shes bla na med// ltos shig ltos shig rigs kyi bu// zhes brjod la slob ma rnams kyi lus gnad bshig ste 'dug tu bcol la ye shes phebs pa'i rtags kyi mtshan nyid glur blang ba ni/ sku lus la bab pa rnam pa gsum// gar dang mkha' spyod 'gro ba dang*// rnal 'byor ma yi sku nyid thob// gsung ngag la bab pa rnam pa gsum// sna tshogs smra dang chos rnams ston// brjod med gsung nyid thob pa'o// thugs sems la bab pa rnam pa gsum// mi rtog pa dang bden pa mthong*// shes dang shes bya'i rang bzhin dag

/rnal 'byor ma yi thugs nyid thob// phyir mi ldog par the tshom med// ces ngo sprad par bya'o// gnyis pa me tog dor ba ni/ slob mas me tog sngar byin pa'am yang na bla mas yum gyi rtsa sngags bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gtad pa de me long gi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dor ba'i mos pas/ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ/ zhes brjod la me tog dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su gtor ba de bla mas rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar phog par mos la/ me tog de nyid bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar phog pas khyed kyi tshe rabs kun gyi lhag pa'i lhar shes nas/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma me tog dang dbyer med par spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa gyis shig / ces me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rtag tu mi 'bral bar spyi bor sgoms shig / ces brjod pas sbyin par bya'o// gsum pa spyan 'byed cing lha ngo bstan pa ni/ khyed rnams kyis thog mar sindhū ra ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas/ thams cad mkhyen gzigs ye shes kyi spyan du gyur par mos mdzod/ oṃ badzra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥ zhes (243) brjod la spyan dar bkrol lo// de nas lha ngo bstan pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs mngon sum du mjal bar mos pa gyis shig kyai rigs kyi bu mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la ltos shig /'di mthong ba tsam gyis rigs gzhan du dman par grub pa mtha' dag las grol ba yin no// gsang ba bla na med pa'i gnas rnams 'dzin pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bcu la ltos shig /'di mthong ba tsam gyis theg pa'i gnas ngan len mtha' dag las grol ba yin no// byin rlabs gyi rtsa ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la ltos shig /'di mthong ba tsam gyis 'khor 'das rang bzhin gyis rang sar dag ste/

don da lta nyid du mthar phyin pa la the tshom med pa yin no// phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong rnams la ltos shig /'di mthong ba tsam gyis bdud dang rgol ba ngan pa thams cad zil gyis gnon par nges pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad par bya'o// de ni ye shes kyi 'khor lo ru gzhug pa'o// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la lnga ste/ bum pa'i dbang dang*/ gsang ba'i dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ tshigs dbang dang*/ byin rlabs bdud rtsis dbang bskur ba'o/ dang po ni/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ dbang dngos gzhi zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ kye kye gsang ba chen po dgongs su gsol// skye med sku la brjod med gsung*// rtog med thugs kyi bum pa'i dbang*// bdag la sku drin stsal du gsol// ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas bla mas bum pa slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzung la/ bum pa 'di khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag nas dbang bskur bas bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rab tu mi gnas pa'i ye shes khyod kyi rgyud la 'phos par sgoms shig / ces brjod la dpon slob gnyis kas bsgoms la bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ rang byung bcom ldan rnal 'byor ma// gsang gsum bla med gnas las byung*// bder gshegs kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje ye shes dbang bskur sbyin// oṃ badzra wā rā hī/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ ces cung zad lag tu blugs la btung du gzhug / ji (244)ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams= lha yi= de bzhin dag pas sku= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas bum chu cung zad sbyin pas spyi bo la sogs bkru'o// dag pa brjod pa ni/ de ltar bum pas dbang bskur bas lus kyi dri ma dag kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa sprul pa'i sku lhan skyes ye shes kyi rnal 'byor mar gyur/ bum pa'i dbang thob pa'i rtags su rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par sgoms mdzod/

rjes gnang la thog mar bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i rjes su gnang ba la rtsa ba bdun yan lag lnga dang bcu gsum yod pa'i dang po ni/ bla mas nor bu slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rin chen zungs zhig bu// zhes brjod nas brda sprad pa ni/ rin po che 'di'i brda yis mtshon nas bla ma dam pa spyi bor 'bral med du sgoms shig de nas rnal 'byor ma'i sku byin la/ mtshon pa sku yi dkyil 'khor du// brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zung*// zhes brda 'di yis mtshon nas lus lha ngag sngags sems ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar sgoms shig ces pa'o/ / snying po sngags kyi 'khor lo byin la/ yig sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du// smin lam yid bzhin nor bu zung*// zhes pa'i brda yis mtshon nas rgyu lam 'bras bu'i dbang rnams zung zhig ces pa'o/ / gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa byin la/ phyag mtshan thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu bzang*// zhes pa'i brdas mtshon nas gzhi lam 'bras bu'i man ngag rnams zung zhig ces pa'o/ / yon tan mtshon pa mda' gzhu byin la/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i// lam mchog rmad byung 'di zung zhig /ces pa'i brdas mtshon nas thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug tu spyod cig ces so// phrin las ni sna tshogs rdo rje phyin la/ sna tshogs nor bu ci bzhin du// sna tshogs rab 'byams las rnams zung*// zhes pa'i brdas mtshon nas zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i las rab 'byams sgrubs shig ces pa'o// mchod pa ni 'ja' tshon byin la/ 'gags med ye shes rol pa can// 'dod yon sna tshogs spyod cig bu// zhes pa'i brdas (245)mtshon nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'dod yon rtag tu spyod cig / ces pa'o// de dag ni rtsa ba bdun gyi brda dbang ngo*// yan lag la lta sgom spyod 'bras dam tshig dang lnga las dang po ni/ me tog byin la/

u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// 'di ni de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi gsang*// bzung du yod de bstan du med// des na khyad 'phags thabs 'di zung*// zhes pa'i brdas mtshon nas lta ba dri ma med pa rang bzhin gyis bsam gyis mi khyab par zung zhig ces pa'o// de nas nyi zla sgom pa'i brda don bzung nas/ brda 'di yis mtshon nas kun rtog gi mun pa nyid gdod ma nas 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo yin pa la yin bzhin du sgoms shig ces pa'o// de nas shes rab kyi ral gri byin nas/ brda 'dis mtshon nas shugs 'byung 'gags med kyi ye shes de nyid rang shar thogs med du spyod cig ces pa'o// phag gi dbu byin la/ brda 'dis mtshon te stong nyid snying rje'i 'bras bu lhun grub kyi ngo bo la re dogs med do zhes pa'o// de bzhin du rin po che man shel byin la/ brda 'dis mtshon te dam tshig la dri ma med par zung dang yon tan sna tshogs 'gags med du 'char ro zhes pa'o // de dag ni brda dbang bcu gsum te bum pa'i dbang grub pa'o// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi slob ma'i spyi bor bzung la/ hūm̐ rang byung bcom ldan rnal 'byor ma// gsang dbang bla med gnas las byung*// bde gshegs kun gyis phyag byas pa// snyan brgyud kyi yig cha snga ma la phyi bum dbang gi brda bcu gcig nang gsang dbang gi brda bcu gcig gsang ba sher dbang gi brda drug dang nyer brgyad byung yang 'dir de rnams bsdom par mdzad pa'o// byang sems bdud rtsis dbang bskur ro// zhes spyi bor bzhag cing lag tu cung zad sbyin la btung*/ bdud rtsi'i btung bas khyod rang gi lus rtsa gnas kyi pho brang thams cad byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang nas bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ ngag gi dri ma dag kun gzhi'i ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lhan skyes ye shes kyi rnal 'byor mar gyur pas gsang ba'i dbang thob pa la dga' ba bsgom par byos (246)shig

dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sindhū ra'i me long gi dkyil 'khor spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ rang byung bcom ldan rnal 'byor ma// gsang gsum bla med gnas las byung*// bder gshegs kun gyis phyag byas pa// lhan skyes dga' ba'i dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod sindhū ra'i srin lag gis blangs la slob ma'i dpral bar thig le byas la/ khyod rang gi dpral bar stong pa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil ba dmar po g.yon du 'khor bar sgoms mdzod/ gsang gnas su thig le byas la/ bha gar lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil ba dmar po g.yon du 'khor bar sgoms/ snying gar thig le bya/ de gnyis kyang gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor bsam mdzod/ des khyod la bde ba chen po ye shes mchog tu mi 'gyur ba rgyud la skyes/ sems kyi dri ma dag ngo bo nyid kyi kun gzhi chos kyi sku lhan skyes ye shes kyi rnal 'byor mar gyur/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa la dga' ba sgoms shig

de nas dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur ba ni/ bla mas rdo rje phyag tu bsnams nas 'di la ltos shig byas la lan gsum du gsor te/ phyag rgya chen po'i zhing khams na// bde chen rnal 'byor ma dpal bzhugs// byar med rtsol med skye 'chi med// mtshan nyid bral ba bsam mi khyab// de yang ming tsam brda tsam tha snyad tsam mo// zhes brjod pa brda don ngo sprad pa ni/ rdo rje ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes so// lag mthil ni de yi gnas so// lan gsum gsor ba ni gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin no/ des rang bzhin gyis rnam par dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag /kun gzhi'i khams nyid lhan cig skyes ma'i sku lhan skyes ye shes kyi rnal 'byor mar gyur/ tshig dbang rin po che thob pa la dga' ba bsgom par bya'o// brgyud pa'i byin rlabs bdud rtsis dbang bskur ba ni/ bhandha lcang lo can slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal bdud rtsi'i gzugs// bdud rtsi he ru ka'i rang bzhin// mi zad sku yi 'khor lo'i dbang*// gang bsten grol lo bu (247)rnams kye// zhes lag pa g.yas par bdud rtsi cung zad blugs nas byin la btung du bcug khyod kyi lag pa g.yas par byin zhing lce la bzhag ste btung bas la la nā'i rtsa gang bas sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob par sgoms mdzod/ yang spyi bor bzung nas/ hūm̐ rnal 'byor ma dpal bdud rtsi'i gzugs// bdud rtsi rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin// mi zad gsung gi 'khor lo'i dbang*// gang bsten grol lo bu rnams kye// zhes lag pa g.yon par bdud rtsi blugs nas byin la btung*/ khyod kyi lag pa g.yon par byin zhing btung bas ra sa nā'i rtsa gang bas gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dbang thob par bsgom/ de nas snying gar bzung la/ hūm̐ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa// mkha' 'gro chos kyi sku can gyi// 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi 'di// bla ma brgyud par legs 'ong ba'i// bdud rtsi'i rgyun lam ma chad par// mi zad thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dbang*// gang bsten grol lo bu rnams kye// zhes lag pa gnyis kar byin nas lce la bzhag cing btung bas dhū tī'i rtsa gnas gang nas thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dbang thob par bsam mo// des ni khams kyi gnas bde ba chen po'i sku lhan skyes ye shes kyi rnal 'byor mar gyur/

sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob pa la dga' ba bsgom par byos shig / 'dir bdud rtsi'i phan yon cung zad bshad par bya ste/ gsang rgyud kyi bshad rgyud las/ sha chen dam tshig mchog gi ni// rdo rje gsum po mchog 'grub 'gyur// bshang gci dam tshig mchog gi ni// rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso mor 'gyur// zhes sogs rgyas par pha rgyud las kyang gsungs la/ ma rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ mi bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pas// nad rnams thams cad spangs pa'o// rtag pa yis ni bde chen po// rdo rje nyi mas tsha rims sel// don yod grub pa rgyal po che// rdo rje nus pa 'byung bar 'gyur// dpal ldan don kun 'grub par byed// de phyir rnal 'byor pas bsten bya// mi bskyod 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa// lo ni lnga stong bar du rol// rtag (248)pa yis ni khri ru brjod// rdo rje nyi mas bye bar 'gyur// tshe dpag med pas grangs med de// mdun gyi nam mkhar ji bzhin bshad// rdo rje nyi ma dpag med gnyis// rtsa bar bsdus pa bsgrub pa'o// 'di gnyis bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pa// kun tu bzang dang mnyam pa 'gyur// shes rab pha rol phyin ye shes// rdo rje nyi ma zhes ni brjod// chos rnams kun gyi thabs la ni// de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med// sangs rgyas rdo rje can nyid kyi// thabs dang shes rab skyed byed pa// khams gsum po ni thams cad bsdu// sa 'og sa steng sa bla yi// khrag dang khu ba'i rang bzhin bsdu// rdo rje dbang phyug gis ni gsungs// sen mo sha dang de bzhin khams// khu ba la ni spyan ras gzigs// pags pa khrag ni snang byed che// rkang dang tshil bu rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad mgon// mgon po'i klad pa rta mgrin rgyal// de la yan lag sangs rgyas lnga// rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa'o// sa yi khams ni rnam dag pas// spyan ni 'khor lo 'dzin ldan ma// rdo rje btsun mo'i de bzhin chu// drod ni padma'i bu mo'o// rgyud dag bas ni sgrol ma ste// bzhi ni rdo rje'i btsun mo'o// de dag gur gyis gsungs pa ste// rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya'o// ces sogs gsar rnying gi rgyud sde thams cad nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i bcud len dang dngos grub gnyis kyi rtsa bar gsungs pa ltar yid ches par bya'o// de ni dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa'o// gsum pa rjes su gnang ba ni bzhi ste/

gsang gsum mchog gi rjes su gnang ba dang*// byin rlabs 'bral med kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ khyad par dam tshig gi rjes su gnang ba dang*// gzhan don phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang*// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bcu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po ldem ldem khyug khyug pa re byung nas slob ma'i smin mtshams su zhugs/ so so'i 'od zer gyi rgyud las so so'i sku yi (249)gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo so so'i sku kha dog dkar po gzi brjid dang ldan pa re rer byon nas dpral bar thim// yang thams cad kyi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po byung nas mgrin par zhugs pa'i rgyud nas so so'i sku kha dog dmar po re rer byon nas mgrin par thim/ yang thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po re byung nas snying gar phog pa'i rgyud nas so so'i sku kha dog sngon po re rer byon nas snying gar thim pas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad rang la rdzogs pas sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang thob par sgoms mdzod// gnyis pa 'bral med kyi rjes su gnang ba ni// bla ma dang me long gi sindhū ra srin lag gis byugs shing rjes zlos kyi tshul du dpon slob gnyis kas ngag tu brjod pa ni// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang mi 'bral shog /mtshan ldan bla ma rje dang mi 'bral shog / mgrin par byugs la/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bcu dang mi 'bral shog /rje btsun tai lo pa dang mi 'bral shog / snying gar byugs la/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rnams dang mi 'bral shog

/lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma dang mi 'bral shog / yan lag kun tu byugs la/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// chos skyong srung ma rnams dang mi 'bral shog /ye shes mgon po rnams dang mi 'bral shog / ces brjod la byin no// gsum pa khyad par dam tshig gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phyi'i dam tshig rnams dang*// nang gi dam tshig brgyad kyis bsdus pa dang*/ phyi nang gi dam tshig ma nyams par srung bar gyis shig / ces brjod par bya'o// bzhi pa gzhan don phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba ni// snyan brgyud kyi glegs bam slob ma'i lag tu gtad la// deng nas bzung ste srid zhi ji srid bar// lhan skyes ye shes gsang ba'i rnal 'byor (250)ma// sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las dpag med kyis// sems dang sems mchog ma lus don grub mdzod// kye rigs kyi bu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ gzhan yang gdul bya mchog rnams kyi don gyis shig /de ni rjes su gnang ba ste dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ma lus pa thob pa yin pas bla ma la gus pa sogs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig mtha' dag srung snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// zhes sogs dang*/ deng nas bzung ste bdag bran du// zhes sogs brjod pa dang gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul lo// 'di ni yum bka'i gzhung ma nyams par gzhan gyi don du dbang bskur ba'i rim pa yin la/ rang gis sgrub mchod byas nas bdag 'jug len pa lta bu la ni/ slob ma la brjod bya thams cad bzhag la gzhan slob ma la ci ltar bskur ba'i lag len ltar rang gis dbang len pa'i tshul de shes par bya'o// spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ thog mar tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i rim pa ni/ sngon nas bshams pa'i tshogs rdzas rnams phud chu chang gis bran zhing nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi gtor la/

oṃ badzra khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang zhing thog mar nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po zhes pa nas/ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas kyang 'thus par 'dug na'ang rgyas par spro na/ yab bka' las 'byung ba'i tshogs lha spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig bla ma rnams bzhengs shig / ces sogs bla ma yi dam chos skyong spyan drangs la/ hūm̐ phyag rgya chen po'i gzhal yas nas// bka' brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas la// zhes sogs tshang bar tshogs chen ltar tshogs rdzas bstab cing tshogs phud sogs bzhag gong du gtor bsngos ma byas pa'am/ byas kyang chos skyong bka' srung rnams kyi gtor chog mchod 'grigs skong bshags la sogs dus skabs dang bstun te rgyas bsdus ci ltar rigs pa byed pa shin tu gal che zhing*/ yum bka' 'di shin tu bka' gnyan pas tshogs gtor bskang gsol gal che gsungs nas nan tan mdzad pa'i srol 'dug go /de nas rdo rje slob dpon nas bzung ste dkyil 'khor pa rnams la (251) tshogs phud 'bul ba bdud rtsi 'gyed pa sogs rdzas bstab pa'i lan dang bcas pa yab bka' dang tshogs chen gyi dus ltar byas nas tshogs la longs spyad/ phud lhag bsdus nas slob dpon gyi lhag mas gong mnan zhing slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i bar nas chang gi kha phru'i bdud rtsi bran la/ hūm̐ gzhan yang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma// zhes sogs bzhi ka 'don ba phag mo'i lugs yin snang bas de ltar bya/ rdo rje'i glu sngags dang tshig gi sgo nas len/ 'bul gtor bdun po rdo rje phag mo/ mkha' dbyings bde chen/ gnas mchog nyer bzhi/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro yan lha so bdun dang*/ bka' srung e ka dzā ṭi/ lha mo dud sol ma/ chos skyong phyag bzhi pa rnams 'di'i bka' srung yin pas 'bul/ de nas lhag po yod na dur khrod brgyad dang dbang mo nyer brgyad/

tshe ring ma brtan ma rnams la 'bul/ de nas rjes kyi cho ga dngos la mchod pa kha gsos nas/ byin rlabs dang mchod bstod rgyas bsdus long skabs dang bstun par byas la bzod par gsol ba ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// zhes sogs yab bka'i cho ga ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gyis bzod gsol dang*/ yig brgya/ 'dod gsol smon lam gdab pa rnams bya'o// bkra shis brjod pa yab bka' rgyas pa ltar yang legs mod kyis/ hūm̐ bka' brgyud bla mas legs byin pa'i// zhes sogs kyi shis pa rgyas par brjod pa ni snyan brgyud yum bka'i lugs yin pas legs par mngon no// rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgya bod grub thob brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud kyi// bcud kyi yang zab smin byed zab mo'i lam// 'dren mchog bla mas bka' stsal rjes gnang zhing*// gus ldan slob mas bskul ngor bkod 'di yang*// gzhung las gzhan pa'i slad 'khris ma bcug cing*// dgongs don ci bzhin bkod par mos na yang*// go rim 'khrul dang brjod pa de'i tshig zur sogs// nongs pa chos bdag mkha' 'gros bzod bzhes la// sgrib med tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol// rnam dkar dge ba'i legs tshogs gang mchis pa// chos bdag gong ma rnams dang chos bdag la// mchod pas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun lam gyis// sgrub brgyud chu bo'i klung ltar rgyas pa des// ma rgan sems can smin cing grol gyur cig /ces snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i yum bka' rgyas pa'i cho ga dbang chog dang bcas pa 'di yang*/ bya bral kun dga'i ming can gyis rmo nyin dkar lha yi pho (252)brang du 'brug lo zla ba dang po'i yar tshes bzang po la bris pa shū bha mastu sarba dza ga tā ma/ bkra shis par gyur cig dge'o// legs so/// /
